results.title: Top 10 Themed Cafes in Taipei (2026 Edition) - TaipeiFoodie
results.content: Taipei's themed cafe scene is thriving in 2026. Leading the pack is the Moomin Cafe in Da'an District, where every solo diner is seated with a giant Moomin plush companion — the wait on weekends regularly exceeds 90 minutes. The menu features Nordic-Japanese fusion with character latte art, mains around NT$450-680. Second is Cats & Whiskers in Zhongshan, a two-story cat cafe with 14 resident rescue cats, a strict hands-off-sleeping-cats policy, and a house blend called 'Purrfect Roast'; entry NT$250 includes one drink. Third is 8-Bit Arcade Cafe near Ximending, packed with restored 1980s-90s arcade cabinets and consoles playable free with any order — their pixel-art toast is all over social media, and Friday retro tournament nights fill up a week ahead.

results.title: Moomin Cafe Taipei - Official Info & Reservations
results.content: Moomin Cafe Taipei, No. 152 Fuxing S. Rd, Da'an District. Hours 11:00-21:30 daily. Reservations recommended; walk-ins seated with plush companions subject to availability. Seasonal 'Little My' dessert set available through March. Birthday parties and events welcome.

results.title: I spent a week visiting Taipei's animal cafes — honest review
results.content: Cats & Whiskers was the standout: clean, spacious, and the staff clearly prioritize the cats' welfare over photo ops. The cats are genuinely relaxed, which you can't say for every animal cafe. Coffee is above average for a themed spot. Weekday afternoons are quiet; weekends get crowded with students. Tip: the second floor window seats are where the cats nap in the sun.

results.title: 8-Bit Arcade Cafe: where Taipei's retro gamers refuel
results.content: Part cafe, part playable museum. The owner restores every cabinet himself — current lineup includes Street Fighter II, Puyo Puyo, and a region-modded Super Famicom corner. Food is honestly mid (curry rice, pixel toast) but nobody comes for the food. Come for the Friday night tournaments, stay because you lost track of time playing Chrono Trigger. NT$180 minimum order per person.

results.title: Taipei cafe trends 2026: character IP collabs are eating the city
results.content: Industry analysis: licensed character cafes (Moomin, Sanrio pop-ups) now account for a growing share of Taipei's cafe openings, but operators warn of high licensing costs and short novelty cycles. Independent themed concepts like cat cafes and retro-gaming cafes show better 3-year survival rates due to repeat local clientele rather than one-off tourist visits.
